task: N01 -- long-range conditional ranking diagnostic under a fixed seed budget
revision: N01-R (offline corrections; no new diffusion, no change of condition)

graph.node_mapping: ascending original ca-GrQc node id -> contiguous index 0..n-1

protocol.graph_reading: undirected simple graph; each edge becomes two propagation directions
protocol.bidirectional_randomness: the two directions are sampled independently
protocol.common_random_numbers: one live/dead state per directed arc per world, shared by all four seed sets of a comparison; NOT per-set re-seeding

two_hop_source_convention.note: the condition holds under both readings (with and without the source node in the 0-to-2-hop receptive field), so the frozen comparisons are unaffected by which convention the definition of R2 intends

statistics.note: the superseded value came from applying the quantile at 1-0.05/(2N) instead of 1-0.05/(4N); corrected offline without re-simulating

class_level_argument.statement: for a scorer whose per-node receptive field is confined to L hops and whose total is a sum of per-node scores, no output node's field may contain candidates from both the {a,b} side and the {c,d} side, else the mixed difference need not vanish
class_level_argument.proves: a relation among the FOUR specified configurations only
class_level_argument.does_not_prove: that the model is additive over seed sets in general
class_level_argument.superseded_claim: the earlier modular form Sigma_hat(S) = sum_{v in S} phi(v) + const, and the five random score vectors used to 'verify' it, are withdrawn: a general two-layer GNN is not modular, and 'sum of per-node outputs' is not 'sum of per-node scores'

official_simba_forward_pass.reason: no torch/numpy/scipy in this environment and no network route to fetch https://github.com/yl489/rethink-IM (github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com and the PyPI index are all unreachable), so the official SpreadPredictor could not be instantiated; a substitute network was NOT used

supplementary_probe.reason_not_extended: relaxing the cross-side exclusion removes the hypothesis of the local-dependency argument, so the probe no longer carries any proxy-identity guarantee; a reversal found there could not be attributed to the original model's limitation

dropped: (R2(a) u R2(b)) n (R2(c) u R2(d)) = empty
relaxed_condition.rationale: the dropped clause forces X_c == X_d identically and makes the test vacuous

note: prediction-structure check is stored here, separate from the real-diffusion results in N01_results.csv / N01_worlds.json.gz
